categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared argument and settings handling functions in src/common/args.cpp and src/common/args.h.
categories.rationale: This PR is an internal cleanup that removes thin wrapper overloads in favor of explicit std::optional::value_or() calls. The author notes that removing the wrappers "decreases complexity at the foundation" and offers a "slight decrease in complexity of pending PR #31260", while reviewer l0rinc confirms these were "thin wrappers that just delegated to the existing std::optional-returning overloads".
